data.description:
# Create Enemy Gym Scene work items

## Problem statement

Create individual Phaser gym scenes for each enemy type defined in the GDD (E1–E5 + Boss). Each scene demonstrates the enemy's formation/movement patterns, sprites, sounds, and (where applicable) shooting behaviour in isolation. Each scene includes buttons to explode a random enemy and toggle shooting behaviour.

## Children (one per enemy)

| Enemy | Work Item | Priority | Key Behaviour |
|-------|-----------|----------|---------------|
| E1 — Scout | **Create E1 Scout gym scene (AH-0MT994ESD000RP1Q)** | high | V-formation/line movement, aimed shots (L4+) |
| E2 — Diver | **Create E2 Diver gym scene (AH-0MT99G6310070UXM)** | high | Curved dive trajectory, spread shots (L4+) |
| E3 — Tank | **Create E3 Tank gym scene (AH-0MT99I2OC0014MNZ)** | high | Slow formation, radial burst (L4+) |
| E4 — Phaser | **Create E4 Phaser gym scene (AH-0MT99K3FE008CT13)** | medium | Orbital paths, predictable radial patterns (L5) |
| E5 — Swarm | **Create E5 Swarm gym scene (AH-0MT99N53O0077KHC)** | medium | Fast clusters, sudden direction changes, coordinated bursts (L4) |
| Boss — Central AI | **Create Boss (Central AI) gym scene (AH-0MT99QBDW001O7PE)** | medium | 4-phase health bar, complex bullet patterns |

## Scope per scene

- Phaser scene with only that enemy type (no player ship, no other enemies, no HUD, no power-ups)
- Visual representation per GDD §4.1 (§7.1 neon aesthetic)
- Movement/formation pattern per GDD §4.1–4.2
- Explosion animation when enemy is destroyed
- Toggle button for enemy-firing behaviour (off = formation only, on = shooting)
- Audio per GDD §7.3 requirements
- Enemy pass-through verified (per GDD §2.6)

## Related work

- **Create gym scene with player ship (AH-0MT97BW7M0056S8S)** — related; player ship will eventually be added to enemy gym scenes. Status: blocked, intake_complete.
- **Refactor Enemy Gym Scenes (AH-0MT985FOA008JWM9)** — sibling; refactors reusable code from first 3 enemy gym scenes. Depends on E1, E2, E3.
- **Gym index scene (AH-0MT985VRY009JXLZ)** — sibling; entry page linking to all enemy gym scenes. Depends on first enemy scene completion.
- **Game Design Document (AH-0MT7O8KCY0059RA5)** — authoritative spec for all enemy types.

## Risks and assumptions

- **Assumption — player ship integration:** Initial enemy gym scenes do not include a player ship; the separate gym scene (AH-0MT97BW7M0056S8S) establishes the player entity first.
- **Assumption — no external art assets:** All enemy sprites can be drawn programmatically (neon shapes) or via simple placeholders.
- **Risk — audio asset creation:** Distinct sound effects per enemy require audio assets. Mitigation: use simple synthesized sounds initially; replace with polished audio later.
- **Scope-creep guard:** Each enemy gym scene contains ONLY that enemy type. No player ship, no other enemies, no HUD, no power-ups, no score/lives. These are isolated testbeds, not gameplay levels.

# Effort and Risk Report

## Effort Estimate

- **T-shirt size:** Large
- **Three-point (PERT):** O=25.00h, M=40.00h, P=64.00h
- **Expected (E=(O+4M+P)/6):** 41.50h
- **Recommended (with overheads):** 86.50h
- **Range:** [70.00h — 109.00h]
- **Unit:** hours

### Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)

| # | Item | O (h) | M (h) | P (h) | Expected (h) |
|---|------|-------|-------|-------|-------------|
| 1 | Create E1 Scout gym scene | 3.00 | 5.00 | 8.00 | 5.17 |
| 2 | Create E2 Diver gym scene | 4.00 | 6.00 | 10.00 | 6.33 |
| 3 | Create E3 Tank gym scene | 3.00 | 5.00 | 8.00 | 5.17 |
| 4 | Create E4 Phaser gym scene | 5.00 | 8.00 | 12.00 | 8.17 |
| 5 | Create E5 Swarm gym scene | 4.00 | 6.00 | 10.00 | 6.33 |
| 6 | Create Boss (Central AI) gym scene | 6.00 | 10.00 | 16.00 | 10.33 |


## Risk Assessment

- **Risk Score:** 0/25 — **Low**
- **Probability:** 0.0/5 | **Impact:** 0.0/5

### Top Risk Drivers & Mitigations

1. **E1 Scout gym scene** — Add targeted tests and integration checks
2. **E2 Diver gym scene** — Lock dependencies and add compatibility tests
3. **E3 Tank gym scene** — Schedule extra review for risky components


## Confidence

- **Confidence:** 74%
- **Unknowns:** Exact sprite art approach (programmatic vs placeholder assets); Audio asset availability and quality expectations; Whether enemy gym scenes need to eventually integrate with the player gym scene
- **Assumptions:** All enemy gym scenes follow the same structural pattern established by the first implementation; Enemy sprites can be drawn programmatically or via simple placeholders; Simple synthesized sound effects are acceptable initially; Player ship is not part of enemy gym scenes (separate work item); Phaser v3 + TypeScript scaffold exists from bootstrap work item
